text_en:
A. 

 By judgment of 17 December 2019, the Police Court of B. acquitted A. of the charge of failing to comply with an official decision.
   

B. 

By judgment of 7 April 2020, the Criminal Division of the Cantonal Court of the Republic and Canton of Neuchâtel, ruling on the appeal lodged by the Public Prosecutor’s Office against that judgement, set it aside to the effect that A. is sentenced, for failure to comply with an official decision, to a fine of 2,500 francs.
   

The cantonal court found the following facts.

B.a 

 A., born in 1969, has been a journalist for around twenty years. He works for C. SA at the free daily newspaper D. This newspaper has a very wide circulation in French-speaking Switzerland, in particular through leaflet boxes placed in heavily frequented locations – such as major railway stations – as well as via an online edition.
   

B.b 

 On (...), the Criminal Court of E. (hereinafter: the Criminal Court) held a trial hearing in F., in proceedings against the perpetrator of a double intentional homicide committed in (...) against his ex-partner and her close friend. One of the elements of the prosecution’s case was that the offences had taken place in the presence of one of the defendant’s minor children and his former partner. The defendant admitted to having killed both victims and did not dispute that one of the children might have witnessed the crimes.
    

The guardian of the defendant’s children had requested a complete closure of the proceedings, so that the fact that one of the children was present at the time of the crimes would remain unknown to the general public. The criminal court ordered a partial closure of the proceedings; journalists were permitted to attend the hearing, but not the public.

B.c 

 As soon as the hearing opened early in the morning on (...), the President of the Criminal Court addressed the journalists present, including A., in the following terms:
   

“For your information, a request for a full closed-door hearing has been made by one of the parties. Aware of the role the media plays in our society, but also of the importance of media freedom, the Criminal Court has ordered a partial closed-door hearing, which allows you to be present today. However, the Criminal Court, with a view to protecting and safeguarding as far as possible the children shared by the defendant and one of the victims, would ask that the media representatives present here refrain from disclosing any information relating to the children. More specifically, the Criminal Court would like to ensure that the children cannot be located or identified. Furthermore, it wishes to ensure that the public is not made aware of what the children did or did not see, or what they did or did not endure, in connection with the facts we will be judging over the coming days. The Criminal Court urges the media to respect this so that the present case does not once again have a far-reaching and negative impact on the children, who are still suffering as a result of this situation.”

B.d 

 The Criminal Court then proceeded to question the defendant. During this questioning, the presence of one of the children at the time of the offences was raised.
 

B.e 

    The online edition of D. published, during the questioning, at 11.23 am, under the byline “A.” and the subheading “A man in his fifties is on trial for killing his partner and her new boyfriend in […]”, an article stating that a full closed-door hearing had been requested, in particular to protect the couple’s children, but that the president of the criminal court, having noted that the children were still suffering as a result of the situation, had decided to grant only a partial closed-door hearing. The article summarised, sometimes with direct quotations, the statements already made by the defendant. In particular, it mentioned the defendant’s explanations regarding the first two shots fired at the victims, then stated:
   

“It was then that he reportedly realised a child was there, witnessing the killings. ‘We spoke briefly and cried together on his bed, then I smoked a cigarette whilst the child was packing his things. I went back down to the kitchen to ring my mother, so that she could come and take him into her care’. It was then that he realised that J. was still alive [and finished him off]”.


It appears that an article by the same author, published on the same day shortly before the one mentioned above, also stated the child’s gender and specified their age; this information was subsequently removed.
   

B.f 

 The children’s guardian became aware of this article and reiterated her request for a complete closure of proceedings. The other parties were invited to state their position on the application, after which the criminal court withdrew to deliberate.
   

At 12.05 pm, the hearing resumed and the criminal court delivered the following decision orally, to be recorded in the minutes:

“Media representatives are prohibited from reporting any information that would make the children of the defendant and the victim traceable or identifiable, or that relates to what they may or may not have seen, or what they may or may not have endured, in connection with the facts of the case. This is subject to the provisions of Article 292 of the Swiss Criminal Code, which stipulates: ‘Any person who fails to comply with a decision served upon them under threat of the penalty provided for in this Article by a competent authority or official shall be liable to a fine’. Furthermore, and pursuant to
Article 63 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
should a further breach of this nature occur, the Court will remove the person responsible from the courtroom.”

B.g 

 The examination of the defendant then resumed and was completed. The hearing was adjourned from 12.30 pm to 1.30 pm, after which the parties presented their arguments.
   

During the afternoon hearing, the children’s guardian requested via email that D. remove any references to the child from the article published online, reiterating the prohibition order issued by the President of the Criminal Court. The newspaper’s editorial team did not comply as hoped, stating that news of the crimes had already reached the child’s close circle, but that they had refrained from mentioning the child’s gender (...) as well as their age.

At 4.35 pm, with the closing arguments concluded and the defendant having spoken last, the criminal court adjourned the hearing to deliberate in camera.

B.h 

 On (...), in (...), D. published an article on its website, written by A., concerning the case. This article noted that the crimes had been committed in (...) and recounted the sequence of events, in particular that the defendant, after breaking into his ex-partner’s home, had shot the man in the head, then shot the woman, before returning to her as she lay dying to finish her off with a second shot. The article also stated the following:
   

    “In the view of both the Public Prosecutor’s Office and the lawyers for the civil parties, G. acted out of revenge, hatred and jealousy, ‘like a monster of cold-bloodedness’. Without even caring that one of the children had witnessed the scene.”
    

B.i 

 In an interview he gave on (...) to radio station H., A. also mentioned the presence of a child during the crimes. In particular, he said:
   

“At the start of the hearing, the media present were asked to avoid mentioning details about these children. However, a very serious and very important piece of information, which had been concealed until then, was revealed during the hearing. The accused had in fact shot his ex-partner and the other man in front of one of the children. [...] We refused to censor ourselves despite the pressure we came under yesterday”.

B.j 

 On (...), a new article was published on D.’s website, by “A./ats” and titled “[...] murder [...]: 20 years’ imprisonment”. It reported on the judgement handed down that day by the criminal court, which convicted the defendant of murder. The article stated, in particular:
   

“The Court found that the man in his fifties had shown ‘cold-bloodedness’ and acted in a ‘despicable’ manner in order to restore his honour. This was despite the fact that a child he had had with his ex-partner was present at the scene of the crime.”

B.k 

 No other media outlet at the time mentioned the presence of one of the children at the time of the crimes, nor did they report any facts concerning these children, with the exception of the radio station that broadcast A.’s statements during his interview. The other media outlets cited other factors to explain the classification as murder, emphasising the particularly heinous nature of the crime.
 

C. 

 A. lodged an appeal in criminal matters with the Federal Supreme Court against the judgment of 7 April 2020, claiming, with costs and expenses, primarily that the judgment be set aside so that he is acquitted and, in the alternative, that it be quashed and the case referred back to the lower court for a new decision.
   

D. 

When called upon to give its opinion, the cantonal court referred to the contested judgment, whilst the Public Prosecutor’s Office moved for the appeal to be dismissed. A. submitted observations regarding these submissions.

text_fr:
A.
    Par jugement du 25 juin 2019, le Tribunal pénal de la Sarine a reconnu A. coupable de tentative d'instigation à assassinat, lésions corporelles simples, vol, dommages à la propriété d'importance mineure, contrainte, séquestration et enlèvement (ch. 1) et l'a condamné à 10 ans de privation de liberté ainsi que 100 fr. d'amende (ch. 2). A. a été astreint à suivre un traitement thérapeutique ambulatoire (ch. 3). Les conclusions civiles formulées par B. ont été admises et A. condamné à lui verser la somme de 15'000 fr. plus accessoires légaux à titre d'indemnité pour tort moral (ch. 5). Ce jugement se prononce, en outre, sur diverses confiscations, respectivement le sort de biens séquestrés (ch. 4). Il règle également les questions liées aux indemnités et frais de procédure (ch. 6, 7, 8 et 9).
B.
    Saisie par A., par arrêt du 13 mai 2020, la Cour d'appel pénal du Tribunal cantonal fribourgeois a rejeté l'appel et a pris acte de l'entrée
    en force des ch. 3 à 7 du jugement de première instance (traitement ambulatoire, confiscation, conclusions civiles, indemnité du défenseur d'office du prévenu et indemnisation du mandataire gratuit de la partie plaignante), le ch. 10 de ce dispositif (maintien en détention pour des motifs de sûreté) étant devenu sans objet (ch. I). Elle en a, par ailleurs, confirmé les ch. 1, 2, 8 et 9. Cet arrêt se prononce, enfin, sur les frais de la procédure d'appel (ch. II) ainsi que les indemnités dues aux défenseurs d'office pour cette même procédure (ch. III).
Très brièvement résumé, l'état de fait sur lequel repose cet arrêt se présente comme suit. On renvoie, pour le surplus, à cet arrêt et à ce qui sera exposé ci-dessous.
B.a
    A. et B. née C. se sont mariés en 2008. Ils ont eu trois enfants, nés en 2009, 2010 et 2015. En juillet 2017, le couple s'est séparé et B. a quitté le domicile conjugal. Le 11 septembre 2017, vers 23h45, A. a surpris son épouse dans sa voiture alors qu'elle entretenait une relation intime avec un tiers. Il l'a sortie de force du véhicule, à moitié dévêtue, et l'a emmenée dans son atelier. Il a ensuite ramené près de sa voiture B. afin de récupérer le téléphone portable de celle-ci. De retour dans son atelier, il lui a ordonné de déverrouiller l'appareil afin de pouvoir en consulter le contenu. Vers 1h00, il l'a ramenée à son véhicule et l'a laissée quitter les lieux.
B.b
    Entre le 30 novembre et le 27 décembre 2017, alors qu'il se trouvait au domicile de son épouse pour garder leurs enfants, A. a dérobé une clé. Il a, par la suite, pénétré chez elle en son absence, lacéré un pantalon en similicuir appartenant à B. et lui a dérobé une paire de baskets, son alliance ainsi qu'un bon [à valoir] dans une maison d'hôte.
B.c
    Entre le mois de février et le 3 mai 2018, A. a demandé à D. d'éliminer, contre rémunération, une personne qui s'est révélée être B. D. lui a fait croire qu'il entrait dans son jeu et a dénoncé les faits à la police le 3 mai 2018.
C.
    A. recourt en matière pénale au Tribunal fédéral contre cet arrêt. Il conclut avec suite de frais et dépens, principalement, à la réforme de cette décision en ce sens qu'il soit condamné pour tentative d'instigation à meurtre, la cause étant renvoyée à la cour cantonale pour nouvelle décision sur la quotité de la peine et les frais judiciaires. A titre subsidiaire, il ne demande que le renvoi de la cause à la cour cantonale pour nouvelle décision sur ce dernier point. Il requiert, par ailleurs, le bénéfice de l'assistance judiciaire.
Le Tribunal fédéral a rejeté le recours dans la mesure où il est recevable.
text_de:
A. 

 Mit Urteil vom 25. Juni 2019 befand das Strafgericht der Saane A. der versuchten Anstiftung zum Mord, der einfachen Körperverletzung, des Diebstahls, geringfügige Sachbeschädigung, Nötigung, Freiheitsberaubung und Entführung (Ziff. 1) für schuldig und verurteilte ihn zu 10 Jahren Freiheitsentzug sowie einer Geldstrafe von 100 Franken (Ziff. 2). A. wurde zur Teilnahme an einer ambulanten therapeutischen Behandlung verpflichtet (Ziff. 3). Den von B. geltend gemachten zivilrechtlichen Ansprüchen wurde stattgegeben, und A. wurde verurteilt, ihm einen Betrag von 15'000 Fr. zuzüglich der gesetzlichen Nebenkosten als Entschädigung für immateriellen Schaden zu zahlen (Ziff. 5). Dieses Urteil entscheidet zudem über verschiedene Einziehungen bzw. die Verwendung beschlagnahmter Vermögenswerte (Ziff. 4). Es regelt ebenfalls die Fragen im Zusammenhang mit Entschädigungen und Verfahrenskosten (Ziff. 6, 7, 8 und 9).
   

B. 

Auf die von A. eingelegte Berufung hin wies das Strafrechtsappellationsgericht des Kantonsgerichts Freiburg mit Urteil vom 13. Mai 2020 die Berufung ab und nahm das Inkrafttreten
    

 Rechtskraft der Ziffern 3 bis 7 des erstinstanzlichen Urteils (ambulante Behandlung, Einziehung, zivilrechtliche Anträge, Entschädigung des Pflichtverteidigers des Angeklagten und Entschädigung des unentgeltlichen Bevollmächtigten der Privatklägerin) zur Kenntnis, wobei Ziff. 10 dieses Tenors (Fortdauer der Haft aus Sicherheitsgründen) gegenstandslos geworden war (Ziff. I). Im Übrigen hat sie die Ziffern 1, 2, 8 und 9 bestätigt. Dieses Urteil entscheidet schliesslich über die Kosten des Berufungsverfahrens (Ziff. II) sowie über die den Pflichtverteidigern für dasselbe Verfahren zustehenden Entschädigungen (Ziff. III).
   

Sehr kurz zusammengefasst stellt sich der Sachverhalt, auf dem dieses Urteil beruht, wie folgt dar. Im Übrigen wird auf dieses Urteil und die nachstehenden Ausführungen verwiesen.

B.a 

 A. und B., geb. C., heirateten im Jahr 2008. Sie hatten drei Kinder, die 2009, 2010 und 2015 geboren wurden. Im Juli 2017 trennte sich das Paar, und B. verließ die eheliche Wohnung. Am 11. September 2017 gegen 23:45 Uhr überraschte A. seine Ehefrau in ihrem Auto, während sie mit einem Dritten intim wurde. Er zog sie halb entkleidet gewaltsam aus dem Fahrzeug und brachte sie in seine Werkstatt. Anschließend brachte er B. zurück zu ihrem Auto, um ihr Mobiltelefon an sich zu nehmen. Zurück in seiner Werkstatt befahl er ihr, das Gerät zu entsperren, um dessen Inhalt einsehen zu können. Gegen 1:00 Uhr brachte er sie zurück zu ihrem Fahrzeug und ließ sie den Ort verlassen.
   

B.b 

 Zwischen dem 30. November und dem 27. Dezember 2017, als er sich im Haus seiner Ehefrau aufhielt, um auf ihre Kinder aufzupassen, entwendete A. einen Schlüssel. Anschließend drang er in ihrer Abwesenheit in ihre Wohnung ein, zerriss eine Kunstlederhose von B. und entwendete ihr ein Paar Turnschuhe, ihren Ehering sowie einen Gutschein für eine Pension.
   

B.c 

 Zwischen Februar und dem 3. Mai 2018 bat A. D., gegen Bezahlung eine Person zu beseitigen, bei der es sich, wie sich herausstellte, um B. handelte. D. täuschte vor, auf sein Spiel einzugehen, und meldete den Sachverhalt am 3. Mai 2018 der Polizei.
   

C. 

 A. legt in Strafsachen beim Bundesgericht Berufung gegen dieses Urteil ein. Er beantragt unter Auferlegung der Kosten und Auslagen in erster Linie die Abänderung dieses Urteils in dem Sinne, dass er wegen versuchter Anstiftung zum Mord verurteilt wird, wobei die Sache zur erneuten Entscheidung über das Strafmass und die Gerichtskosten an das Kantonsgericht zurückverwiesen wird. Hilfsweise beantragt er lediglich die Rückweisung der Sache an das Kantonsgericht zur erneuten Entscheidung über diesen letzten Punkt. Er beantragt zudem die Gewährung von Prozesskostenhilfe.
 

Das Bundesgericht hat die Beschwerde, soweit sie zulässig ist, abgewiesen.
text_it:
A. 

 Con sentenza del 25 giugno 2019, il Tribunale penale della Sarine ha riconosciuto A. colpevole di tentata istigazione all’omicidio, lesioni personali semplici, furto, danni alla proprietà di entità minore, coercizione, sequestro di persona e rapimento (punto 1) e lo ha condannato a 10 anni di privazione della libertà e a una multa di 100 franchi (punto 2). A. è stato obbligato a sottoporsi a un trattamento terapeutico ambulatoriale (punto 3). Le domande civili formulate da B. sono state accolte e A. è stato condannato a versargli la somma di 15'000 franchi più le spese legali a titolo di risarcimento per danno morale (punto 5). Tale sentenza si pronuncia, inoltre, su varie confische e sul destino dei beni sequestrati (punto 4). Regola altresì le questioni relative ai risarcimenti e alle spese processuali (punti 6, 7, 8 e 9).
   

B. 

 Adita da A., con sentenza del 13 maggio 2020, la Corte d’appello penale del Tribunale cantonale di Friburgo ha respinto l’appello e ha preso atto dell’entrata
    

 dell’entrata in vigore dei punti da 3 a 7 della sentenza di primo grado (trattamento ambulatoriale, confisca, domande civili, indennizzo del difensore d’ufficio dell’imputato e indennizzo del rappresentante pro bono della parte civile), essendo venuto meno l’oggetto del punto 10 di tale dispositivo (mantenimento in detenzione per motivi di sicurezza) (punto I). Ha inoltre confermato i punti 1, 2, 8 e 9. La presente sentenza si pronuncia, infine, sulle spese del procedimento d’appello (punto II) nonché sugli onorari dovuti ai difensori d’ufficio per lo stesso procedimento (punto III).
   

Riassumendo molto brevemente, lo stato di fatto su cui si fonda la presente sentenza si presenta come segue. Per il resto, si rimanda alla sentenza stessa e a quanto verrà esposto di seguito.

B.a 

 A. e B., nata C., si sono sposati nel 2008. Hanno avuto tre figli, nati nel 2009, nel 2010 e nel 2015. Nel luglio 2017, la coppia si è separata e B. ha lasciato la residenza coniugale. L’11 settembre 2017, verso le 23.45, A. ha sorpreso la moglie nella sua auto mentre aveva un rapporto intimo con un terzo. L’ha fatta uscire con la forza dal veicolo, mezza svestita, e l’ha portata nel suo laboratorio. Ha poi ricondotto B. vicino alla sua auto per recuperare il suo cellulare. Una volta tornati nel suo laboratorio, le ha ordinato di sbloccare il telefono per poterne consultare il contenuto. Verso l’1:00, l’ha riaccompagnata alla sua auto e le ha permesso di andarsene.
   

B.b 

 Tra il 30 novembre e il 27 dicembre 2017, mentre si trovava a casa della moglie per badare ai figli, A. ha rubato una chiave. Successivamente, si è introdotto nell’abitazione in sua assenza, ha strappato un paio di pantaloni in similpelle appartenenti a B. e le ha sottratto un paio di scarpe da ginnastica, la sua fede nuziale e un buono [di soggiorno] presso una pensione.
   

B.c 

 Tra il mese di febbraio e il 3 maggio 2018, A. ha chiesto a D. di eliminare, a pagamento, una persona che si è rivelata essere B. D. gli ha fatto credere di stare al suo gioco e ha denunciato i fatti alla polizia il 3 maggio 2018.
   

C. 

 A. ha presentato ricorso in materia penale dinanzi al Tribunale federale contro questa sentenza. Chiede, con riserva di spese e onorari, in via principale, la riforma di tale decisione affinché sia condannato per tentata istigazione all’omicidio, con rinvio della causa al tribunale cantonale per una nuova decisione in merito all’entità della pena e alle spese processuali. In subordine, chiede solo il rinvio della causa al tribunale cantonale per una nuova decisione su quest’ultimo punto. Chiede inoltre il beneficio del gratuito patrocinio.
 

Il Tribunale federale ha respinto il ricorso nella misura in cui è ammissibile.
text_en:
A. 

 By judgment of 25 June 2019, the Sarine Criminal Court found A. guilty of attempted incitement to murder, simple bodily harm, theft, minor damage to property, coercion, unlawful detention and abduction (para. 1) and sentenced him to 10 years’ imprisonment and a fine of 100 francs (para. 2). A. was ordered to undergo outpatient therapeutic treatment (para. 3). The civil claims brought by B. were upheld and A. was ordered to pay him the sum of 15,000 francs plus statutory costs as compensation for non-pecuniary damage (para. 5). This judgment also rules on various confiscations and the disposition of seized property (para. 4). It further settles matters relating to compensation and costs of the proceedings (paras. 6, 7, 8 and 9).
   

B. 

On appeal by A., by judgment of 13 May 2020, the Criminal Appeals Chamber of the Fribourg Cantonal Court dismissed the appeal and took note of the entry
    

 of sections 3 to 7 of the first-instance judgment (outpatient treatment, confiscation, civil claims, remuneration for the defendant’s court-appointed defence counsel and compensation for the complainant’s pro bono representative), with paragraph 10 of that operative part (continued detention on grounds of public safety) having become moot (paragraph I). It also upheld paragraphs 1, 2, 8 and 9. Finally, this judgment rules on the costs of the appeal proceedings (paragraph II) and the fees due to court-appointed defence counsel for those proceedings (paragraph III).
   

Very briefly summarised, the facts on which this judgment is based are as follows. For further details, reference is made to this judgment and to the points set out below.

B.a 

 A. and B. (née C.) married in 2008. They had three children, born in 2009, 2010 and 2015. In July 2017, the couple separated and B. left the marital home. On 11 September 2017, at around 11.45 pm, A. caught his wife in her car whilst she was engaging in an intimate act with a third party. He forcibly pulled her out of the vehicle, half-undressed, and took her to his workshop. He then took B. back to her car to retrieve her mobile phone. Back in his workshop, he ordered her to unlock the phone so that he could view its contents. At around 1.00 am, he took her back to her car and let her leave.
   

B.b 

 Between 30 November and 27 December 2017, whilst he was at his wife’s home looking after their children, A. stole a key. He subsequently entered her home whilst she was away, slashed a pair of faux-leather trousers belonging to B. and stole a pair of trainers, her wedding ring and a voucher for a guesthouse.
   

B.c 

 Between February and 3 May 2018, A. asked D. to kill, in return for payment, a person who turned out to be B. D. led him to believe that he was playing along and reported the matter to the police on 3 May 2018.
   

C. 

 A. is appealing this judgment to the Federal Supreme Court in criminal matters. He claims costs and expenses and, primarily, seeks to have this decision set aside so that he is convicted of attempted incitement to murder, with the case being referred back to the cantonal court for a new decision on the severity of the sentence and the legal costs. In the alternative, he seeks only that the case be referred back to the cantonal court for a fresh decision on this latter point. He also applies for legal aid.
 
BGE 147 IV 249, para. 251

The Federal Supreme Court dismissed the appeal in so far as it was admissible.

text_fr:
A.
Il 24 novembre 2020 A., nata nel 1992, si è recata presso il grande magazzino B. SA di Z. Salita al reparto casalinghi, si è impossessata di un coltello con una lama seghettata della lunghezza di 21 cm e, individuata a caso una donna tra le persone presenti, le si è avvicinata da tergo e l'ha colpita al collo cagionandole un taglio di almeno 10 cm alla gola e uno al mento. Dopo che la vittima giaceva a terra, A. le ha inferto ulteriori colpi dall'alto verso il basso, causandole altre ferite agli arti superiori. Compiendo l'aggressione, A. ha gridato "Allahu akbar". In seguito, si è diretta verso un'altra donna presente nel reparto, tentando di colpire anch'ella con il coltello. Non è tuttavia riuscita nel suo intento, giacché l'aggredita è riuscita a bloccarle il polso della mano in cui teneva il coltello, evitando così di essere colpita. Alcune persone presenti in loco sono in seguito riuscite a disarmare e ad immobilizzare A. fino all'arrivo della Polizia.
B.
In relazione a questi fatti, con sentenza del 19 settembre 2022, la Corte penale del Tribunale penale federale (TPF) ha riconosciuto A. autrice colpevole di ripetuto tentato assassinio. L'imputata è inoltre stata riconosciuta autrice colpevole di violazione dell'art. 2 della legge federale del 12 dicembre 2014 che vieta i gruppi "Al-Qaïda" e "Stato islamico" nonché le organizzazioni associate (in seguito: legge Al-Qaïda/Stato islamico [LAQ/SI]; RU 2014 4565), segnatamente per avere inviato tramite Facebook, tra il 7 ottobre 2020 e il 20 novembre 2020, messaggi e fotografie a sostegno dello Stato islamico. A., che è pure stata dichiarata colpevole di ripetuto esercizio illecito della prostituzione, tenuto conto di una scemata imputabilità di grado medio, è stata condannata alla pena detentiva di 9 anni, da dedursi la carcerazione preventiva sofferta e la pena espiata anticipatamente, nonché alla multa di fr. 2'000.-. Nei suoi confronti è stato ordinato un trattamento stazionario ai sensi dell'
art. 59 cpv. 3 CP
 e l'esecuzione della pena è stata sospesa per dar luogo allo stesso.
C.
Contro il giudizio di primo grado, il Ministero pubblico della Confederazione (MPC) ha adito la Corte di appello del TPF. Dal canto suo, l'imputata ha presentato un appello incidentale. Entrambe le parti hanno essenzialmente impugnato il dispositivo concernente la condanna per violazione della legge Al-Qaïda/Stato islamico e quello relativo alla commisurazione della pena. Il MPC ha chiesto che la condanna per il reato di violazione dell'art. 2 LAQ/SI comprendesse anche i fatti del 24 novembre 2020, mentre l'imputata ha chiesto il proscioglimento da tale imputazione. Con sentenza del 21 agosto 2023, la Corte d'appello del TPF, accertato il passaggio in giudicato
dei dispositivi del giudizio di primo grado non impugnati, ha riconosciuto l'imputata autrice colpevole di violazione dell'art. 2 LAQ/SI in relazione ai fatti del 24 novembre 2020 e l'ha condannata alla pena detentiva di 10 anni e 6 mesi, da dedursi la carcerazione preventiva sofferta e la pena espiata anticipatamente, nonché alla multa di fr. 2'000.-. Diversamente dal tribunale di primo grado, la Corte d'appello del TPF ha ammesso l'esistenza di un concorso ideale tra il reato di ripetuto tentato assassinio e quello di violazione dell'art. 2 LAQ/SI.
D.
A. impugna questa sentenza con un ricorso in materia penale al Tribunale federale, chiedendo in via principale di riformarla nel senso di proscioglierla dall'imputazione di violazione dell'art. 2 LAQ/SI e di condannarla a una pena detentiva di 7 anni e 11 mesi e alla multa di fr. 2'000.-. Chiede inoltre di accertare la violazione degli
art. 3 CEDU
 e 8 cpv. 2 Cost. con riferimento alle sue condizioni di detenzione nel periodo dal 24 maggio 2021 al 2 ottobre 2023, tenendo conto di detto accertamento nell'ambito della commisurazione della pena. Chiede pure la riduzione della quota delle spese procedurali poste a suo carico. In via subordinata, la ricorrente chiede di essere prosciolta dall'imputazione di violazione dell'art. 2 LAQ/SI e di annullare per il resto la sentenza impugnata, rinviando gli atti alla precedente istanza perché si pronunci sulle condizioni detentive sotto il profilo degli
art. 3 CEDU
 e 8 cpv. 2 Cost. e statuisca nuovamente sulla commisurazione della pena. La ricorrente postula inoltre di essere ammessa al beneficio dell'assistenza giudiziaria e del gratuito patrocinio per la procedura dinanzi al Tribunale federale. Fa valere la violazione del diritto federale e dell'
art. 3 CEDU
.
La Corte d'appello del TPF chiede di respingere il ricorso nella misura della sua ammissibilità. Il MPC chiede di respingere il gravame e di confermare la sentenza impugnata.
Il Tribunale federale ha respinto il ricorso nella misura della sua ammissibilità.

A. 
Am 24. November 2020 begab sich A., geboren 1992, begab sich zum Kaufhaus B. AG in Z. In der Haushaltswarenabteilung nahm sie ein Messer mit einer 21 cm langen gezackten Klinge an sich und wählte willkürlich eine Frau aus der Anwesenheit aus, näherte sie sich ihr von hinten und stach ihr in den Hals, wodurch sie eine mindestens 10 cm lange Schnittwunde an der Kehle und eine am Kinn davontrug. Nachdem das Opfer am Boden lag, versetzte A. ihr weitere Stiche von oben nach unten und fügte ihr dadurch weitere Verletzungen an den oberen Gliedmaßen zu. Während des Angriffs rief A. „Allahu akbar“. Anschließend ging sie auf eine andere Frau in der Abteilung zu und versuchte, auch diese mit dem Messer zu attackieren. Dies gelang ihr jedoch nicht, da es der Angegriffenen gelang, ihr das Handgelenk der Hand, in der sie das Messer hielt, festzuhalten und so einen Stich zu verhindern. Einige Anwesende konnten A. anschließend entwaffnen und festhalten, bis die Polizei eintraf.

B. 
Im Zusammenhang mit diesen Vorfällen hat die Strafkammer des Bundesstrafgerichts (BStGer) A. mit Urteil vom 19. September 2022 wegen wiederholten versuchten Mordes für schuldig befunden. Die Angeklagte wurde zudem wegen Verstoßes gegen Art. 2 des Bundesgesetzes vom 12. Dezember 2014 zum Verbot der Gruppen „Al-Qaida“ und „Islamischer Staat“ sowie der mit ihnen verbundenen Organisationen (im Folgenden: Al-Qaida/Islamischer Staat-Gesetz [LAQ/SI]; RU 2014 4565), insbesondere weil sie zwischen dem 7. Oktober 2020 und dem 20. November 2020 über Facebook Nachrichten und Fotos zur Unterstützung des Islamischen Staates versendet hatte. A., die zudem der wiederholten illegalen Ausübung der Prostitution für schuldig befunden wurde, wurde unter Berücksichtigung einer mässig geminderten Schuldfähigkeit zu einer Freiheitsstrafe von 9 Jahren verurteilt, wobei die bereits verbüßte Untersuchungshaft und die vorzeitig verbüßte Strafe anzurechnen sind, sowie zu einer Geldstrafe von Fr. 2'000.-. Gegen sie wurde eine stationäre Behandlung gemäss
Art. 59 Abs. 3 StGB
 angeordnet, und der Vollzug der Strafe wurde zugunsten dieser Behandlung ausgesetzt.

C. 
Gegen das erstinstanzliche Urteil legte die Bundesanwaltschaft (BA) beim Berufungsgericht des Bundesgerichts (TPF) Berufung ein. Die Angeklagte ihrerseits legte eine Anschlussberufung ein. Beide Parteien haben im Wesentlichen den Tenor bezüglich der Verurteilung wegen Verstoßes gegen das Al-Qaida-/Islamischer Staat-Gesetz sowie den Tenor bezüglich der Strafzumessung angefochten. Die Bundesanwaltschaft beantragte, die Verurteilung wegen Verstoßes gegen Art. 2 Al-Qaida-/IS-Gesetz auch auf die Taten vom 24. November 2020 auszudehnen, während die Angeklagte den Freispruch von diesem Anklagepunkt beantragte. Mit Urteil vom 21. August 2023 hat das Berufungsgericht des Bundesgerichts, nachdem es die Rechtskraft festgestellt hatte 
der nicht angefochtenen Teile des erstinstanzlichen Urteils als rechtskräftig anerkannt, die Angeklagte wegen Verstoßes gegen Art. 2 LAQ/SI im Zusammenhang mit den Taten vom 24. November 2020 für schuldig befunden und sie zu einer Freiheitsstrafe von 10 Jahren und 6 Monaten verurteilt, wobei die bereits verbüßte Untersuchungshaft und die vorzeitig verbüßte Strafe anzurechnen sind, sowie zu einer Geldstrafe von 2'000 Franken. Im Gegensatz zum Gericht erster Instanz hat das Berufungsgericht des Bundesgerichts (TPF) das Vorliegen eines ideellen Zusammenwirkens zwischen dem Delikt des wiederholten versuchten Mordes und dem Delikt des Verstosses gegen Art. 2 LAQ/SI anerkannt.

D. 
A. legt gegen dieses Urteil eine Strafrechtsbeschwerde beim Bundesgericht ein und beantragt in erster Linie, das Urteil dahingehend abzuändern, dass sie vom Vorwurf des Verstoßes gegen Art. 2 LAQ/SI freizusprechen und sie zu einer Freiheitsstrafe von 7 Jahren und 11 Monaten sowie zu einer Geldstrafe von 2'000.- Franken zu verurteilen. Er beantragt zudem, die Verletzung der 
Art. 3 EMRK
 und Art. 8 Abs. 2 BV festzustellen, und zwar im Hinblick auf ihre Haftbedingungen im Zeitraum vom 24. Mai 2021 bis zum 2. Oktober 2023, wobei diese Feststellung bei der Strafzumessung zu berücksichtigen sei. Sie beantragt ferner die Herabsetzung des ihr auferlegten Anteils an den Verfahrenskosten. Hilfsweise beantragt die Beschwerdeführerin, vom Vorwurf des Verstoßes gegen Art. 2 LAQ/SI freigesprochen zu werden und das angefochtene Urteil im Übrigen aufzuheben sowie die Akten an die Vorinstanz zurückzuverweisen, damit diese über die Haftbedingungen unter Berücksichtigung der 
Art. 3 EMRK
 und Art. 8 Abs. 2 der Bundesverfassung zu beurteilen und erneut über die Strafzumessung zu entscheiden. Die Beschwerdeführerin beantragt zudem, ihr für das Verfahren vor dem Bundesgericht Prozesskostenhilfe und unentgeltliche Rechtsvertretung zu gewähren. Sie macht eine Verletzung des Bundesrechts und von
Art. 3 EMRK
.

Das Berufungsgericht des Bundesgerichts beantragt, die Beschwerde, soweit sie zulässig ist, abzuweisen. Die Bundesanwaltschaft beantragt, die Beschwerde abzuweisen und das angefochtene Urteil zu bestätigen.

Das Bundesgericht hat die Beschwerde, soweit sie zulässig ist, abgewiesen.

A. 
On 24 November 2020, A., born in 1992, went to the B. SA department store in Z. Upon entering the household goods department, she took a knife with a serrated blade 21 cm long and, having randomly selected a woman from among those present, approached her from behind and struck her on the neck, inflicting a cut of at least 10 cm to her throat and another to her chin. After the victim was lying on the floor, A. inflicted further blows from top to bottom, causing additional injuries to her upper limbs. Whilst carrying out the attack, A. shouted “Allahu akbar”. She then moved towards another woman in the department, attempting to stab her as well. However, she did not succeed, as the victim managed to grab the wrist of the hand in which A. was holding the knife, thereby preventing herself from being stabbed. Several people at the scene subsequently managed to disarm and restrain A. until the police arrived.

B. 
In relation to these events, in a judgement dated 19 September 2022, the Criminal Chamber of the Federal Criminal Court (FCC) found A. guilty of repeated attempted murder. The defendant was also found guilty of breaching Article 2 of the Federal Act of 12 December 2014 prohibiting the groups ‘Al-Qaeda’ and ‘Islamic State’ as well as associated organisations (hereinafter: Al-Qaeda/Islamic State Act [LAQ/SI]; RU 2014 4565), specifically for having sent messages and photographs in support of the Islamic State via Facebook between 7 October 2020 and 20 November 2020. A., who was also found guilty of repeated unlawful engagement in prostitution, taking into account a moderate degree of diminished criminal responsibility, was sentenced to nine years’ imprisonment, from which the time spent on remand and the sentence already served in advance are to be deducted, as well as a fine of CHF 2,000. She was ordered to undergo inpatient treatment pursuant to
Article 59(3) of the Swiss Criminal Code
and the enforcement of the sentence was suspended to allow for this treatment.

C. 
The Office of the Attorney General of Switzerland (OAG) lodged an appeal against the first-instance judgment with the Court of Appeal of the Federal Criminal Court (TPF). For her part, the defendant lodged a cross-appeal. Both parties essentially challenged the operative part of the judgment concerning the conviction for breaching the Al-Qaeda/Islamic State Act and that relating to the determination of the sentence. The OAG requested that the conviction for the offence of breaching Article 2 of the Al-Qaeda/Islamic State Act should also include the events of 24 November 2020, whilst the defendant sought acquittal on that charge. By judgment of 21 August 2023, the Court of Appeal of the Federal Criminal Court, having established that the following parts of the first-instance judgment had become final 
of the uncontested operative parts of the first-instance judgement, found the defendant guilty of breaching Article 2 of the LAQ/SI in relation to the events of 24 November 2020 and sentenced her to 10 years and 6 months’ imprisonment, from which the period of pre-trial detention served and the sentence already served in advance were to be deducted, as well as a fine of CHF 2,000. Unlike the court of first instance, the Court of Appeal of the Federal Criminal Court (TPF) recognised the existence of a concurrent offence between the offence of repeated attempted murder and that of a breach of Article 2 of the LAQ/SI.

D. 
A. is challenging this judgment by lodging a criminal appeal with the Federal Supreme Court, seeking, as her primary claim, to have it set aside so as to acquit her of the charge of breaching Article 2 of the LAQ/SI and to sentence her to a term of imprisonment of 7 years and 11 months and a fine of CHF 2,000. She further requests a finding of a breach of 
Articles 3 of the ECHR
 and Article 8(2) of the Constitution in relation to her conditions of detention during the period from 24 May 2021 to 2 October 2023, taking this finding into account when determining the sentence. She also requests a reduction in the proportion of the procedural costs for which she is liable. In the alternative, the appellant requests that she be acquitted of the charge of breaching Article 2 of the LAQ/SI and that the contested judgment be set aside in all other respects, with the case referred back to the lower court for it to rule on the conditions of detention in the light of 
Article 3 of the ECHR
 and Article 8(2) of the Constitution, and to rule anew on the determination of the sentence. The appellant further requests to be granted legal aid and free legal representation for the proceedings before the Federal Supreme Court. She alleges a breach of federal law and of
Article 3 of the ECHR
.

The Court of Appeal of the Federal Criminal Court (TPF) requests that the appeal be dismissed to the extent that it is admissible. The Office of the Attorney General (MPC) requests that the appeal be dismissed and that the contested judgment be upheld.

The Federal Supreme Court has dismissed the appeal to the extent that it is admissible.

text_fr:
A.-
Marie Kaufmann-Studer, geb. 1914, bewohnte mit ihrem Ehemanne, ihren sieben Kindern im Alter von zwei bis fünfzehn Jahren und ihrem 73 Jahre alten Vater in
Schüpfheim ein eigenes Haus, in dem sie einen Zigarrenladen führte. Obschon aus dem Verdienste des Ehemannes als Fabrikarbeiter monatlich etwa Fr. 700.-- in den Haushalt flossen, geriet die Familie wegen Vergnügungs- und Geltungssucht der Ehefrau immer mehr in Schulden. Vom Juli 1952 bis 12. März 1953 wurde für Forderungen von zusammen Fr. 4785.-- achtundzwanzigmal Hausrat und Ware des Geschäftes gepfändet. Ungefähr während des letzten halben Jahres dieser Zeitspanne sagte Marie Kaufmann, die sämtliche Betreibungsurkunden entgegennahm, ihrem Manne nichts mehr von den Betreibungen. Obschon sie hohe Abschlagszahlungen leistete, kam es bis zum 5. März 1953 wieder zu Betreibungen für Fr. 2384.--. Marie Kaufmann fürchtete immer mehr, ihre sorgfältig verheimlichte Schuldenmacherei werde ihrem Ehemanne und ihrem Vater bekannt, insbesondere als am 16. und 20. März der Betreibungsbeamte bei ihr erschien, einen neuen Zahlungsbefehl brachte und mit ihr über die Rückstände sprach, wobei er darauf hinwies, dass er Ende März die Versteigerung ansetzen müsse, wenn sie nicht eine Nachlassstundung nachsuche und es ihrem Ehemanne nicht gelinge, für zwei Monate den Lohn zum voraus zu beziehen. In ihrer Angst und primitiven Triebhaftigkeit, die mit Oberflächlichkeit ihres Denkens und Fühlens verbunden war, kam sie am 20. März 1953 nach dem Besuche des Betreibungsbeamten auf den Gedanken, ihren Vater und ihren Ehemann umzubringen, damit sie die Versteigerung nicht erlebten. Sie grübelte, wie sie das machen wolle, kam aber zu keinem Schlusse, weil ihr vor der Tat grauste. In der Nacht vom 20./21. März schlief sie nur wenig und in der Nacht vom 21./22. März gar nicht, weil ihr Nachdenken sie immer wieder zum gleichen Ergebnis führte, nämlich dass die beiden Männer die Versteigerung nicht erleben dürften.
Besonders stark beschäftigte der Gedanke sie am Abend des 22. März, einem Sonntag. Der Ehemann hatte sich an diesem Tage auf ihr Betreiben zum Besuche seiner Schwester
nach Weggis begeben. Als sie um 20 Uhr vernahm, ihr Vater habe das Nachtessen mit der Bemerkung abgelehnt, es solle fressen, wer Hunger habe, entschloss sie sich nach langem inneren Kampfe, ihn zu töten, damit er nicht am folgenden Morgen ihren Ehemann über die Lage der Familie unterrichte. Gegen 21 Uhr schickte sie die beiden älteren Kinder zum Bahnhof ihren Vater abholen; die anderen Kinder waren schon zu Bett gegangen. Dann nahm sie eine Axt, vergewisserte sich von der Laube her, dass Vater Studer schlief, ging in das Zimmer, schlug dem Schlafenden mit mehreren Axthieben den Schädel ein und deckte ihn mit einer Bettdecke zu. Hierauf stellte sie die Axt in die Laube, reinigte in der Küche den mit Blut bespritzten Ärmel und bereitete dem heimkehrenden Ehemanne das Nachtessen zu.
Nach der Mahlzeit begab sie sich mit ihrem Manne zu Bett, blieb aber schlaflos. In schwerem inneren Kampfe entschloss sie sich morgens 3 Uhr des 23. März, auch den Ehemann zu töten, holte die Axt, stellte sie bereit, legte sich wieder zu Bett, brütete weiter vor sich hin, erhob sich gegen 4 Uhr nochmals, ergriff die Axt und zertrümmerte dem Schlafenden mit mehreren Hieben den Schädel. Hernach ging sie in die Küche die blutige Axt waschen, stellte sie in den Keller und begab sich in ihr Bett zurück, die blutüberströmte Leiche ihres Ehemannes unbedeckt im Bette nebenan lassend. Etwas später kam sie auf den Gedanken, einen Raubüberfall vorzutäuschen, ging in den Laden, legte Zigarrenpakete in einen leeren Koffer, räumte die Ladenkasse aus, liess die Schublade offen und öffnete anschliessend zum gleichen Täuschungszwecke auch in der Stube einige Behälter und Türen. Nachher weilte sie noch mehrere Stunden lang neben dem Toten im Bett.
B.-
Am 14. Juli 1954 erklärte das Obergericht des Kantons Luzern Marie Kaufmann des wiederholten Mordes schuldig. Es nahm an, die Einsicht in das Unrecht der Taten habe ihr nicht gefehlt, doch sei ihre Fähigkeit, sich gemäss dieser Einsicht zu verhalten, in mittlerem Grade
herabgesetzt gewesen. Es milderte daher die Strafe gemäss
Art. 11 und 66 StGB
 auf zwanzig Jahre Zuchthaus. Es stellte die Verurteilte für zehn Jahre in der bürgerlichen Ehrenfähigkeit ein. Auf die Freiheitsstrafe rechnete es ihr die seit 23. März 1953 ausgestandene Untersuchungshaft an.
C.-
Marie Kaufmann führt Nichtigkeitsbeschwerde mit dem Antrag, das Urteil sei aufzuheben und die Sache zur Neubeurteilung an das Obergericht zurückzuweisen.
Sie macht geltend, entgegen der Auffassung des Obergerichts habe sie nicht unter Umständen und mit einer Überlegung getötet, die eine besonders verwerfliche Gesinnung offenbarten. Die Verminderung ihrer Zurechnungsfähigkeit schliesse eine besonders verwerfliche Gesinnung aus. Die Gesinnung im Zeitpunkt der Tat könne nur dann eine Rolle spielen, wenn der Sinn des Täters im wesentlichen frei sei, d.h. wenn er besinnen könne, was er tue, und wenn nicht im wesentlichen Impulse, über die er nicht mehr mächtig sei, die Tat bewirkten. Die Beschwerdeführerin habe sich somit nur der vorsätzlichen Tötung (
Art. 111 StGB
) schuldig gemacht.

text_it:
A.- 
Marie Kaufmann-Studer, nata nel 1914, viveva con il marito, i suoi sette figli di età compresa tra i due e i quindici anni e il padre settantatreenne a 
Schüpfheim in una casa di proprietà, dove gestiva un negozio di sigari. Sebbene il reddito mensile del marito, operaio di fabbrica, ammontasse a circa 700 franchi, la famiglia si indebitò sempre più a causa della propensione della moglie al divertimento e alla ricerca di prestigio. Dal luglio 1952 al 12 marzo 1953, per crediti complessivi pari a 4'785 franchi, furono pignorati ventotto volte i beni mobili e la merce del negozio. Circa durante l’ultimo semestre di questo periodo, Marie Kaufmann, che riceveva tutti gli atti esecutivi, smise di riferire al marito delle esecuzioni. Sebbene versasse ingenti acconti, il 5 marzo 1953 si arrivò nuovamente a procedimenti esecutivi per un importo di 2'384 franchi. Marie Kaufmann temeva sempre più che i debiti da lei accuratamente tenuti nascosti venissero alla luce davanti al marito e al padre, soprattutto quando, il 16 e il 20 marzo il funzionario esecutivo si presentò a casa sua, portando un nuovo mandato di pagamento e parlando con lei degli arretrati, sottolineando che avrebbe dovuto fissare l’asta per la fine di marzo se lei non avesse richiesto una moratoria sul pagamento dei debiti e se suo marito non fosse riuscito a prelevare in anticipo lo stipendio di due mesi. Spinta dalla paura e da una primitiva impulsività, unite alla superficialità del suo modo di pensare e di sentire, il 20 marzo 1953, dopo la visita dell’ufficiale esecutivo, le venne in mente di uccidere suo padre e suo marito, affinché non assistessero all’asta. Rimuginò su come farlo, ma non giunse a nessuna conclusione, perché il pensiero di compiere quel gesto la riempiva di orrore. Nella notte tra il 20 e il 21 marzo dormì pochissimo e nella notte tra il 21 e il 22 marzo non dormì affatto, poiché le sue riflessioni la portavano sempre alla stessa conclusione, ovvero che i due uomini non dovevano assistere all’asta.

Quel pensiero la tormentava particolarmente la sera del 22 marzo, una domenica. Quel giorno il marito, su sua insistenza, si era recato a Weggis per fare visita alla sorella 
. Quando alle 20 venne a sapere che suo padre aveva rifiutato la cena dicendo che avrebbe dovuto mangiare solo chi aveva fame, dopo una lunga lotta interiore decise di ucciderlo, affinché non informasse suo marito, la mattina seguente, della situazione della famiglia. Verso le ore 21 mandò i due figli più grandi alla stazione a prendere il padre; gli altri bambini erano già andati a letto. Poi prese un'ascia, si assicurò dalla veranda che il padre Studer dormisse, entrò nella stanza, spaccò il cranio dell'uomo addormentato con diversi colpi d'ascia e lo coprì con una coperta. Successivamente ripose l’ascia nel portico, pulì in cucina la manica macchiata di sangue e preparò la cena per il marito di ritorno a casa.

Dopo il pasto andò a letto con il marito, ma rimase insonne. In preda a un’intensa lotta interiore, alle 3 del mattino del 23 marzo di uccidere anche il marito, prese l’ascia, la tenne a portata di mano, tornò a letto, continuò a rimuginare, si alzò di nuovo verso le 4, impugnò l’ascia e con diversi colpi fracassò il cranio dell’uomo addormentato. Dopodiché andò in cucina a lavare l’ascia insanguinata, la ripose in cantina e tornò nel proprio letto, lasciando il cadavere insanguinato del marito scoperto nel letto accanto. Poco dopo le venne in mente di simulare una rapina, si recò al negozio, mise dei pacchetti di sigari in una valigia vuota, svuotò la cassa, lasciò il cassetto aperto e, sempre a scopo di inganno, aprì anche alcuni contenitori e porte nel salotto. In seguito rimase ancora diverse ore accanto al cadavere nel letto.

B. – 
Il 14 luglio 1954 il Tribunale superiore del Cantone di Lucerna dichiarò Marie Kaufmann colpevole di duplice omicidio. Ritenne che non le fosse mancata la consapevolezza dell’illecito dei fatti, ma che la sua capacità di comportarsi in conformità a tale consapevolezza fosse stata ridotta in misura media 
. Ha pertanto ridotto la pena, ai sensi degli 
artt. 11 e 66 CP
, a venti anni di reclusione. Ha sospeso la capacità civile della condannata per dieci anni. Ha imputato alla pena detentiva il periodo di custodia cautelare scontato a partire dal 23 marzo 1953.

C.- 
Marie Kaufmann presenta ricorso in cassazione chiedendo l’annullamento della sentenza e il rinvio della causa al Tribunale superiore per un nuovo giudizio.

Essa sostiene che, contrariamente a quanto ritenuto dalla Corte d’appello, non abbia ucciso in circostanze e con un intento tali da rivelare un atteggiamento particolarmente riprovevole. La riduzione della sua imputabilità esclude un atteggiamento particolarmente riprovevole. L’atteggiamento mentale al momento del fatto potrebbe avere rilevanza solo se la volontà dell’autore fosse sostanzialmente libera, ovvero se egli fosse in grado di rendersi conto di ciò che sta facendo e se il fatto non fosse determinato essenzialmente da impulsi sui quali egli non ha più alcun controllo. La ricorrente si è quindi resa colpevole solo di omicidio doloso (
art. 111 CP
).
text_en:
A.—
Marie Kaufmann-Studer, née 1914, lived with her husband, her seven children aged between two and fifteen, and her 73-year-old father in 
Schüpfheim in a house of their own, where she ran a cigar shop. Although her husband’s earnings as a factory worker brought in around Fr. 700.-- a month to the household, the family fell deeper and deeper into debt due to the wife’s love of entertainment and desire for prestige. Between July 1952 and 12 March 1953, household goods and shop stock were seized on twenty-eight occasions to cover claims totalling CHF 4,785. During roughly the last six months of this period, Marie Kaufmann, who received all the debt collection notices, stopped telling her husband about the debt collection proceedings. Although she made substantial instalment payments, by 5 March 1953, debt enforcement proceedings were reinstated for Fr. 2,384.--. Marie Kaufmann grew increasingly fearful that her carefully concealed accumulation of debt would become known to her husband and her father, particularly when, on 16 and 20 March, the debt collection officer turned up at her home, brought a new payment order and spoke to her about the arrears, pointing out that he would have to schedule the auction for the end of March unless she applied for a debt restructuring moratorium and her husband managed to to receive two months’ wages in advance. In her fear and primitive impulsiveness, combined with the superficiality of her thoughts and feelings, she came up with the idea on 20 March 1953, following the debt enforcement officer’s visit, she came up with the idea of killing her father and her husband so that they would not have to witness the auction. She pondered how she might go about it, but came to no conclusion because she was horrified at the thought of committing the act. On the night of 20–21 March she slept very little, and on the night of 21–22 March she did not sleep at all, because her thoughts kept leading her to the same conclusion, namely that the two men must not be allowed to witness the auction.

The thought preoccupied her particularly strongly on the evening of 22 March, a Sunday. On that day, at her urging, her husband had set off for Weggis to visit his sister 
. When, at 8 pm, she heard that her father had refused to join them for supper, remarking that ‘whoever is hungry should eat’, she resolved, after a long inner struggle, to kill him so that he would not inform her husband of the family’s situation the following morning. At around 9.00 pm, she sent her two eldest children to the station to collect her father; the other children had already gone to bed. She then took an axe, checked from the arbour to make sure that Mr Studer was asleep, went into the room, smashed the sleeper’s skull with several blows of the axe and covered him with a duvet. She then placed the axe in the arbour, cleaned the blood-spattered sleeve in the kitchen and prepared supper for her husband when he returned home.

After the meal, she went to bed with her husband, but could not sleep. In the throes of a terrible inner struggle, she resolved at 3 o’clock in the morning on 23 to kill her husband as well, fetched the axe, laid it ready, went back to bed, continued to brood, rose again at around 4 o’clock, seized the axe and smashed the sleeping man’s skull with several blows. She then went into the kitchen to wash the bloodstained axe, placed it in the cellar and returned to her own bed, leaving her husband’s blood-soaked body uncovered in the bed next door. A little later, she had the idea of staging a robbery, went to the shop, placed packets of cigars in an empty suitcase, emptied the till, left the drawer open and then, for the same deceptive purpose, also opened several containers and doors in the parlour. Afterwards, she remained in bed beside the dead man for several more hours.

B.— 
On 14 July 1954, the High Court of the Canton of Lucerne found Marie Kaufmann guilty of repeated murder. It found that she had not lacked an understanding of the wrongfulness of her actions, but that her ability to act in accordance with that understanding had been moderately 
impaired. It therefore reduced the sentence in accordance with 
Articles 11 and 66 of the Swiss Criminal Code
 to twenty years’ imprisonment. It suspended the convicted person’s civil rights for ten years. It credited the period of pre-trial detention she had served since 23 March 1953 towards her prison sentence.

C.- 
Marie Kaufmann has lodged an appeal for annulment, requesting that the judgment be set aside and the case referred back to the High Court for a retrial.

She argues that, contrary to the High Court’s view, she did not kill under circumstances or with a state of mind that revealed a particularly reprehensible attitude. The reduction in her criminal responsibility precludes the existence of a particularly reprehensible attitude. The state of mind at the time of the offence can only be relevant if the perpetrator’s mind was essentially free, i.e. if they were able to reflect on what they were doing, and if the act was not essentially caused by impulses over which they no longer had control. The appellant was therefore guilty only of intentional homicide (
Art. 111 StGB
).

A.-
Fritz Christen, geb. 1899, ist deutlich, aber nicht hochgradig debil. Die Schule beendete er nach der sechsten Klasse, da er dreimal wiederholen musste. Beruf erlernte er keinen. Wie schon durch die Mitschüler, wurde er auch durch seine Nebenarbeiter oft ausgelacht. Niemand liebte ihn. Beziehungen zum Weibe vermochte er keine anzuknüpfen. Er überwertete eine Missbildung seines Geschlechtsteils so sehr, dass er sich nur als halber Mensch vorkam. Die chronische Verdrängung seiner agressiven und sexuellen Triebe führte zu einem neurotischen Charakter. Christen entwickelte sich zu einem wortkargen, verschlossenen und misstrauischen Manne, den andere, auch ohne näher mit ihm zu verkehren, als guten Kerl beurteilten. Er war gut beleumdet und hatte sich nie vor dem Strafrichter zu verantworten. Wahrscheinlich wurde schliesslich noch durch den Beginn einer Arteriosklerose sein Hirn verändert.
Am 10. September 1953 gegen 7 Uhr trat Christen von seiner Wohnung an der Dättnauerstrasse in Winterthur-Töss aus den Weg nach dem Kantonsspital an, wo er wegen eines Oberarmbruches eine Nachbehandlung durchmachte. Unterwegs, in der Nähe der Stelle, wo der Kronenrainweg in den Ebnet-Wald führt, traf er die im Jahre 1941 geborene Ursula Weishaupt, die auf dem Wege zur
Schule war. Nachdem er mit dem Mädchen ungefähr fünfzig Meter weit gegangen war, trat es zu einer Sandkiste in der Nähe des Weges und urinierte. Der Anblick des entkleideten Unterleibes des Kindes gab Christen einen solchen Schock, dass seine chronisch gestauten Triebe ausbrachen. Er stürzte sich auf das Mädchen und warf es nieder, um es am Geschlechtsteil ausgreifen zu können. Indem er ihm mit einer Hand den Mund zuhielt und ihm Schürze und Rock über den Kopf stülpte, hinderte er es am Schreien. Mit dem linken Arm den Nacken des Mädchens umfassend und dessen Gesicht gegen seinen Körper pressend, würgte er das Opfer, schleppte es in ein kleines ausgetrocknetes Bachtobel und liess es dort zu Boden fallen. Hierauf schnitt er dem bewusstlosen Kinde mit einem Taschenmesser vorn auf beiden Seiten die Hosen auf, griff ihm mit dem rechten Mittelfinger in die Scheide und tötete es, indem er ihm mit dem Messer fünf Stiche in den Hals und einen Stich in die linke Schulter versetzte und es würgte. Er deckte die Leiche mit Ästen zu, reinigte sich und ging seines Weges nach dem Kantonsspital, führte unterwegs im Autobus mit einem Dritten ein belangloses Gespräch und bewahrte auch im Spital seine Ruhe. Nachher besuchte er eine Wirtschaft, ass und kehrte auf dem Heimweg noch zwei weitere Male ein.
B.-
Am 17. Februar 1955 verurteilte das Obergericht des Kantons Zürich Christen wegen Mordes (
Art. 112 StGB
) zu zwölf Jahren Zuchthaus, abzüglich 491 Tage Untersuchungs- und Sicherheitshaft, und stellte ihn für sieben Jahre in der bürgerlichen Ehrenfähigkeit ein.
Das Gericht nahm übereinstimmend mit dem Sachverständigen an, der.Angeklagte habe in einem Affektdämmerzustande gehandelt, wobei seine Fähigkeit zur Einsicht in das Unrecht der Tat nicht wesentlich beeinträchtigt, jedoch die Fähigkeit, sich gemäss seiner Einsicht zu verhalten, wegen der sensitiven Debilität und der Störungen im Hirn mindestens mittelstark vermindert gewesen sei (
Art. 11 StGB
). Es führte weiter aus, die Begehung
der Tat im erwähnten Zustande schliesse den Vorwurf aus, Christen habe mit einer Überlegung getötet, die seine besonders verwerfliche Gesinnung oder seine Gefährlichkeit im Sinne des
Art. 112 StGB
 offenbaren könnte. Ob dagegen die Umstände der Tat eine besonders verwerfliche Gesinnung oder Gefährlichkeit des Täters verrieten, beurteile sich unabhängig von dessen Geisteszustand. Zu diesen Umständen gehörten auch die Beweggründe. Christen erinnere sich nicht mehr an die Einzelheiten seines Verbrechens und wisse auch nicht, warum er Ursula Weishaupt getötet habe. Die Tat sei nach ihrem Verlaufe ein typischer Lustmord. Es müsse angenommen werden, Christen habe entweder in sexueller Ekstase und zur Befriedigung seines plötzlich hervorbrechenden Geschlechtstriebes gehandelt, oder um die Entdeckung seines Sittlichkeitsdeliktes zu verhindern, oder aus beiden Motiven zugleich. Der eine wie der andere Beweggrund offenbare eine besonders verwerfliche Gesinnung. Auch durch das Verhalten nach der Tat, das von einer grossen Kaltblütigkeit und vom Mangel jeder echten Reue zeuge, habe Christen solche Gesinnung bekundet. Die Umstände der Tat zeigten auch seine Gefährlichkeit, nämlich dass er fähig sei, unter den gleichen oder anderen Umständen ein ähnliches Verbrechen zu begehen. Das psychiatrische Gutachten komme überzeugend zum Schluss, das sei möglich. Dass Christen in heftiger Gemütsbewegung getötet habe, führe nicht zur Anwendung der Bestimmung über Totschlag (
Art. 113 StGB
). Wenn eine Tat die Merkmale des Mordes aufweise, der gegenüber der vorsätzlichen Tötung (Art. 111) qualifizierter Tatbestand sei, könnte sie nicht zugleich den privilegierten Tatbestand des Totschlages erfüllen. Eine Tötung in sexueller Erregung sei zudem nicht entschuldbar.
C.-
Christen führt Nichtigkeitsbeschwerde mit dem Antrag, er sei statt des Mordes des Totschlages, eventuell der vorsätzlichen Tötung, schuldig zu erklären und entsprechend milder zu bestrafen.
D.-
Die Staatsanwaltschaft des Kantons Zürich beantragt, die Beschwerde sei abzuweisen.

text_it:
A.- 
Fritz Christen, nato nel 1899, è affetto da debilità mentale evidente, ma non grave. Ha terminato la scuola dopo la sesta classe, poiché ha dovuto ripetere tre volte l’anno. Non ha imparato alcun mestiere. Come già da parte dei compagni di scuola, veniva spesso deriso anche dai suoi colleghi di lavoro. Nessuno lo amava. Non riusciva a instaurare relazioni con le donne. Attribuiva un’importanza eccessiva a una malformazione dei suoi genitali, al punto da sentirsi solo una mezza persona. La repressione cronica delle sue pulsioni aggressive e sessuali portò a un carattere nevrotico. Christen divenne un uomo taciturno, chiuso e diffidente, che gli altri, anche senza frequentarlo da vicino, giudicavano un bravo ragazzo. Gode di buona reputazione e non ha mai dovuto rispondere delle proprie azioni davanti a un giudice penale. Probabilmente, alla fine, anche l’insorgere di un’arteriosclerosi ha alterato le sue funzioni cerebrali.

Il 10 settembre 1953, verso le 7 del mattino, Christen uscì dal suo appartamento in Dättnauerstrasse a Winterthur-Töss per recarsi all’ospedale cantonale, dove era in cura per una frattura della parte superiore del braccio. Lungo il tragitto, nei pressi del punto in cui il Kronenrainweg immette nel bosco di Ebnet, incontrò Ursula Weishaupt, nata nel 1941, che si recava alla 
scuola. Dopo aver camminato con la ragazzina per circa cinquanta metri, questa si avvicinò a una sabbiera vicino al sentiero e urinò. La vista del basso ventre scoperto della bambina provocò a Christen uno shock tale che i suoi impulsi sessuali, repressi da tempo, esplosero. Si avventò sulla bambina e la gettò a terra per poterle afferrare i genitali. Tappandole la bocca con una mano e infilandole il grembiule e la gonna sopra la testa, le impedì di gridare. Afferrandole il collo con il braccio sinistro e premendole il viso contro il proprio corpo, strangolò la vittima, la trascinò in un piccolo burrone prosciugato e la lasciò cadere a terra. A quel punto, con un coltellino tascabile, tagliò i pantaloni della bambina priva di sensi su entrambi i lati nella parte anteriore, le infilò il dito medio destro nella vagina e la uccise infliggendole con il coltello cinque coltellate al collo e una alla spalla sinistra, oltre a strangolarla. Coprì il cadavere con dei rami, si pulì e proseguì il suo cammino verso l’ospedale cantonale; lungo il tragitto, sull’autobus, intrattenne una conversazione insignificante con una terza persona e mantenne la calma anche in ospedale. Successivamente si recò in una trattoria, mangiò e, sulla via del ritorno, si fermò altre due volte.

B.- 
Il 17 febbraio 1955 la Corte d’appello del Cantone di Zurigo condannò Christen per omicidio (
art. 112 CP
) a dodici anni di reclusione, con detrazione di 491 giorni di custodia cautelare e di sicurezza, e gli sospese per sette anni l’idoneità all’esercizio dei diritti civili.

Il tribunale, in accordo con il perito, ritenne che l’imputato avesse agito in uno stato di affettamento, in cui la sua capacità di comprendere l’illecito del fatto non era stata sostanzialmente compromessa, ma la capacità di comportarsi in conformità con tale comprensione era stata almeno moderatamente ridotta a causa della debolezza sensoriale e dei disturbi cerebrali (
art. 11 CP
). Ha inoltre precisato che la commissione 
del reato in detto stato esclude l’accusa secondo cui Christen avrebbe ucciso con un intento tale da rivelare la sua attitudine particolarmente riprovevole o la sua pericolosità ai sensi dell’
art. 112 CP
. Se invece le circostanze del reato rivelassero un atteggiamento particolarmente riprovevole o una pericolosità dell’autore, ciò andrebbe valutato indipendentemente dal suo stato mentale. Tra queste circostanze rientrano anche i moventi. Christen non ricorda più i dettagli del suo crimine e non sa nemmeno perché abbia ucciso Ursula Weishaupt. Il reato, in base al suo svolgimento, costituisce un tipico omicidio passionale. Si deve presumere che Christen abbia agito o in preda all’estasi sessuale e per soddisfare il proprio impulso sessuale improvvisamente esploso, oppure per impedire la scoperta del proprio reato contro la morale, o ancora per entrambi i motivi contemporaneamente. Sia l’uno che l’altro movente rivelano una mentalità particolarmente riprovevole. Anche attraverso il comportamento tenuto dopo il delitto, che testimonia di grande freddezza e della mancanza di ogni vero pentimento, Christen ha manifestato tale mentalità. Le circostanze del fatto dimostrano inoltre la sua pericolosità, ovvero la sua capacità di commettere un crimine simile in circostanze identiche o diverse. La perizia psichiatrica giunge in modo convincente alla conclusione che ciò sia possibile. Il fatto che Christen abbia ucciso in preda a un forte turbamento emotivo non comporta l’applicazione della disposizione sull’omicidio colposo (
art. 113 CP
). Se un fatto presenta le caratteristiche dell’omicidio, che costituisce un reato più grave rispetto all’omicidio doloso (art. 111), non può contemporaneamente soddisfare gli elementi costitutivi privilegiati dell’omicidio colposo. Inoltre, un omicidio commesso in stato di eccitazione sessuale non è scusabile.

C.- 
Christen presenta ricorso in cassazione chiedendo di essere dichiarato colpevole di omicidio colposo, eventualmente di omicidio doloso, anziché di omicidio, e di essere punito con una pena corrispondentemente più lieve.


D.- 
Il pubblico ministero del Cantone di Zurigo chiede che il ricorso sia respinto.
text_en:
A.— 
Fritz Christen, born in 1899, is clearly, though not severely, mentally disabled. He left school after Year 6, having had to repeat the year three times. He did not learn a trade. Just as he had been mocked by his schoolmates, he was also often laughed at by his fellow workers. Nobody liked him. He was unable to form relationships with women. He overestimated a deformity of his genitals to such an extent that he felt he was only half a man. The chronic repression of his aggressive and sexual urges led to a neurotic personality. Christen developed into a taciturn, withdrawn and distrustful man, whom others, even without knowing him well, regarded as a decent chap. He was of good character and had never been brought before a criminal court. It is likely that the onset of arteriosclerosis ultimately caused changes in his brain.

On 10 September 1953, at around 7 o’clock, Christen set off from his flat on Dättnauerstrasse in Winterthur-Töss on his way to the cantonal hospital, where he was undergoing follow-up treatment for a broken upper arm. On the way, near the point where Kronenrainweg leads into the Ebnet Forest, he met Ursula Weishaupt, born in 1941, who was on her way to 
school. After walking with the girl for about fifty metres, she went over to a sandpit near the path and urinated. The sight of the child’s exposed lower body gave Christen such a shock that his chronically repressed urges erupted. He pounced on the girl and threw her to the ground so that he could reach her genitals. By covering her mouth with one hand and pulling her apron and skirt over her head, he prevented her from screaming. With his left arm wrapped round the girl’s neck and her face pressed against his body, he choked the victim, dragged her into a small, dry stream bed and dropped her to the ground there. He then used a pocket knife to cut open the front of the unconscious child’s trousers on both sides, inserted his right middle finger into her vagina, and killed her by stabbing her five times in the neck and once in the left shoulder with the knife, and by strangling her. He covered the body with branches, cleaned himself up and made his way to the cantonal hospital; on the bus journey, he engaged in trivial conversation with a third person and remained calm whilst at the hospital. Afterwards, he visited a pub, had something to eat and stopped off twice more on his way home.

B.— 
On 17 February 1955, the High Court of the Canton of Zurich sentenced Christen for murder (
Art. 112 of the Swiss Criminal Code
) to twelve years’ imprisonment, less 491 days spent in pre-trial and preventive detention, and suspended his civil rights for seven years.

The court concurred with the expert’s assessment that thedefendant had acted in a state of diminished responsibility, whereby his ability to recognise the wrongfulness of the act was not significantly impaired, but his ability to act in accordance with that recognition had been at least moderately diminished due to sensory debility and brain disorders (
Art. 11 StGB
). It further stated that the commission of 
the offence whilst in the aforementioned state precluded the allegation that Christen had killed with a state of mind that might reveal his particularly reprehensible disposition or his dangerousness within the meaning of 
Art. 112 StGB
. Whether, on the other hand, the circumstances of the offence revealed a particularly reprehensible state of mind or dangerousness on the part of the perpetrator was to be assessed independently of his mental state. These circumstances also included the motives. Christen no longer recalls the details of his crime and does not know why he killed Ursula Weishaupt. Judging by the course of events, the offence was a typical sex murder. It must be assumed that Christen acted either in sexual ecstasy and to satisfy his suddenly surging sexual urge, or to prevent the discovery of his sexual offence, or for both motives simultaneously. Both motives reveal a particularly reprehensible mindset. Christen also demonstrated such a mindset through his behaviour after the crime, which bore witness to great cold-bloodedness and a lack of any genuine remorse. The circumstances of the offence also demonstrated his dangerousness, namely that he was capable of committing a similar crime under the same or different circumstances. The psychiatric report convincingly concludes that this is possible. The fact that Christen killed in a fit of intense emotion does not lead to the application of the provision on manslaughter (
Art. 113 StGB
). If an act exhibits the characteristics of murder, which is a more serious offence than intentional killing (Art. 111), it cannot at the same time fulfil the criteria for the mitigated offence of manslaughter. Furthermore, killing whilst in a state of sexual arousal is not excusable.

C.— 
Christen has lodged an appeal for annulment, requesting that he be found guilty of manslaughter, or alternatively of intentional killing, rather than murder, and that he be given a correspondingly more lenient sentence.


D.- 
The Public Prosecutor’s Office of the Canton of Zurich requests that the appeal be dismissed.
